name: hobb
desc: A barge captain in his fifties, stuck nineteen days in a stopped river queue and grumbling about it: broad and barrel-chested, weathered ruddy face, a heavy grey-streaked brown beard cropped short, deep laugh lines around tired eyes, a knitted ochre cap pushed back off his forehead. He wears a thick ochre-and-brown oilcloth coat over a cable-knit jumper, a coil of mooring line over one shoulder, fingerless wool gloves, and a brass barge-whistle on a cord. Warm-hearted under the complaint.
sheetHint: barrel-chested, short grey-streaked brown beard, knitted ochre cap, ochre oilcloth coat, cable-knit jumper, mooring line over shoulder, fingerless gloves
